scoring_justification: The headline quantities are DFT-computed properties of Fe(IV) complexes. The verifier sandbox cannot run the full DFT pipeline; comparison against paper-reported reference values with tolerances is the appropriate method.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for each complex’s delta_E, spin densities, LUMO character, LUMO energy, EA, and BDE.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: J Mol Model (2016) Table 3 (spin densities), Table 4 (EA/BDE), Fig. 3 description (LUMO character), and supplementary Table S9 (LUMO energies approximated via -EA/23.06).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually extracted numeric values from the paper tables and text. LUMO energies are taken from the reference solve.sh approximation consistent with the supplementary results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the exact numbers reported in the paper for the same quantities and conditions, thus serve as authoritative reference targets.

delta_E_S1_S2.description: Spin-state energy gap (S=1 minus S=2) in kcal/mol; positive if S=2 is lower

outputs.description: JSON file containing the computed spin-state gap, spin densities, LUMO character, electron affinity, and bond dissociation energy for the three Fe(IV)=NTs complexes (dpmp-Cl, dpdm-Cl, salan-Cl) in their most stable pentacoordinate geometry.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares agent-reported values (δE, spin densities, EA, BDE) against paper-reported references with appropriate tolerances. LUMO_character is checked by string matching. The comments field may include methodological notes.
